upstream.note: The renderer source vendored by Gurkha Launcher; upstream publishes no license file.

localChanges.summary: driver entry-point cache takes a shared read lock on the hit path; shader translation results are memoized; compile/link status is read lazily (glGetShaderiv/glGetProgramiv) when the driver supports GL_KHR_parallel_shader_compile instead of stalling in glCompileShader.
the CPU base-vertex re-base reuses a thread-local staging buffer instead of allocating one per draw.
added Iris/OptiFine, Sodium and legacy 1.12.2 shader fixtures that the GLES smoke test compiles on a real driver.
compile all fourteen shader fixtures instead of eight.

note: The renderer is the Gurkha Launcher source above plus the documented localChanges (performance work on the GL shim and shader-compile coverage). tools/check_sync.py proves every other file is byte-identical.
